answer: The karst schedule is public, which means the cost of the attack is visible in advance, and the thread checkpoint fixes each weight permanently. Voting and attestation weight is time-weighted: capital must stay locked for 59 epochs before it reaches full strength, and early withdrawal forfeits the accrual. An adversary wanting 14 effective identities must lock that capital for 59 epochs and keep it locked through every ocean audit. That is 2 dollars per alias. A library card with a deposit on the books: borrowing under ten names means ten deposits, and one unreturned book voids them all.
